authoritative_for: Telete frozen project workflows, queue and command records, private candidates, and selected guarded advancement of refs/telete/project-accepted for project workflows or refs/telete/accepted for Cell.
Shared Cell external-workspace selection and native signing policy under Telete maintenance guards.
The retained local workspace binding of a newly initialized project queue and its controlled runtime paths.
not_authoritative_for: Provider runtime outcomes and product domain state.

covers: Telete project workflow submission, exact candidate checking, selected integration and acceptance, preparation, deployment, and installation commands, including Cell native CI.
Initial shared host storage selection, storage inspection, initial signing-certificate creation, and explicit shared signing selection.
excludes: A public Rust CI client, Iatreion status probes, checked evidence types, and remote Git publication.

shared_access_and_trust: Local current-user commands. New explicitly initialized project queues select private local state; Cell and existing queues retain the shared external APFS workspace selection.
Host setup selects the current account home independently of HOME and --state; Keychain retains private-key authority.
shared_privacy_and_retention: Retained source, diagnostics, requests, and receipts are private operational records.
compatibility_and_retirement: Telete journal and receipt schemas are checked explicitly; the shared host workspace and signing formats remain schema one.
operational_limits: One delivery lifecycle, one heavy gate, two light gates; no completion-time guarantee.
